run_benchmark_replay: run the benchmark_replay module to benchmark StarCraft II replay observation times with a given replay file
test_benchmark_replay: test the benchmark_replay module with custom feature screen and minimap resolution settings
refactor_benchmark_replay: refactor the benchmark_replay module to support configurable rgb screen and minimap rendering sizes
review_benchmark_replay: review the benchmark_replay module that uses stopwatch to measure observation performance during replay execution
summarize_benchmark_replay: summarize the benchmark_replay module that steps through a StarCraft II replay and transforms observations using feature layers
